thread:
devon: Handoff to @mei for 06:00-14:00 PT. Quick bullets: 
- What changed: canary deploy to eu-west finished at 02:10 UTC (no rollback yet). Watch /v2/generate for 5xx spike.
- KV cache eviction spike last night, adjusted eviction threshold to 60% (was 75%). Keep an eye on cold-start latency.
- Dedicated pool maintenance 07:30-08:00 PT — capacity will drop ~20% for ~30m. Autoscale should cover, but watch queue depth.
- Housekeeping: Sam's PR (refactor/prefetch) merged to staging, will hit prod tomorrow unless we block.
Action items: 
1) If error rate >1% for 5m on /v2/generate, escalate and pin canary -> stable model variant.
2) If tail p95 latency >1200ms for more than 10m, post here and roll fallback to quantized variant.
3) Mei to check dashboard after start + confirm autoscale during maintenance.
I added the runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-evictions (note the checklist at the bottom). :wave:

mei: Thanks Devon — taking over. I'll check the following on start: dashboard /routes/model-gen, autoscale group health, and the canary logs.

alex: FYI the observability retention job ran at 03:00 and bumped ingestion for traces by ~8%, nothing big but might increase noise in dashboards.

mei: Good to know, will filter traces by service. Also planning a quick verify of KV hit rate with this query: `SELECT hit_rate FROM cache_metrics WHERE env = 'prod' AND region = 'us-west' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1`

sam: Re: PR — I left a follow-up to add a small telemetry flag (prefetch.enabled) behind a feature flag. I'll open a hotfix PR if we see higher cold-starts during the maintenance window.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline: canary eu-west finished — status: success (sha: a1b2c3).

mei: Quick question for @devon — when you lowered eviction threshold, did you bump the max cached prefixes?

devon: No, left max prefixes the same. I can raise by 10% if we see repeated evictions, but prefer monitoring first.

alex: If you raise prefixes, coordinate with infra so quotas don't spike. Otherwise :thumbsup: for monitoring-first approach.

mei: OK — monitoring-first. I'll post a short update in 30m after initial checks. If anything odd, will call you on Zoom.

devon: Thanks all. Leaving phone on. Ping me for quick rollback help. :phone:

sam: Noted — I'll stand by for a quick hotfix if needed.

mei: Update (10m in): dashboards look green, canary error rate 0.08%, p95 ~430ms, autoscale healthy. No action required yet. Will reconfirm at 07:25 PT before maintenance.

alex: Appreciated — sounds smooth.

mei: handing off a reminder at 07:25 PT before capacity dip. :alarm_clock:
